note: Two parts of the project disagreeing is information, not an inconvenience. Entries are never deleted: resolved entries keep their resolution and who or what resolved them. 'Resolved' by a record correction is not an engineering review.

discrepancies.title: Historical C1 note contradicts its own sweep

sides.says: Baseline is a change-point linkage with a 78.46-101.54 deg transmission angle and confirmed over-center locking.
Baseline row: non-Grashof, 90.0/90.0 deg, envelope 0.0; every one of 81 rows is identical.

discrepancies.found_by: Reading the committed JSON against the note during the evidence review of 2026-09-28.
discrepancies.next_action: None for the record; the design question continues as D-002.
discrepancies.resolution: The note is archived as superseded and the claim no longer repeats its figures.
discrepancies.resolved_by: Record correction in the evidence-discipline change; not an engineering review.

discrepancies.title: The specified four-bar cannot be assembled

sides.says: Ground 25, coupler 60, input 15, output 15 mm deploys the fin 0-92 deg.

Over the 0-92 deg drive range the B-D distance never exceeds 29.6 mm (40 mm at any angle), but the coupler and output circles only meet at 45 mm or more; no pose closes. None of the 81 variants closes at any pose.

discrepancies.found_by: Loop-closure check (circle intersection) added in model revision 2.
discrepancies.next_action: A human confirms the intended topology and link dimensions; then the model is re-run and reviewed.

discrepancies.title: C1 model revision 1 reported placeholders as results, and its tests passed on them

sides.says: transmission_angle() returned 90.0 for poses that cannot close; an empty trajectory produced an envelope of 0.0; the Freudenstein constants were misassigned.
Tests asserted 40-140 deg and a bounded envelope, and passed because the placeholders sat inside those bounds.

discrepancies.found_by: Comparing compute_theta4 with direct circle intersection for a linkage that does close.
discrepancies.next_action: None; keep revision 1 archived as a worked example of a vacuous pass.
discrepancies.resolution: Revision 2 returns null for unassemblable poses and solves closure by circle intersection; tests check geometry and null handling.
discrepancies.resolved_by: Model and test correction in the evidence-discipline change; software-tested, not engineering-reviewed.

discrepancies.title: Over-center locking is claimed but not modeled

sides.says: Over-center detection: confirmed (moment sign flips at toggle).
over_center_moment_sign() compares the drive angle with 92 deg and ignores every link length.

discrepancies.found_by: Reading the helper's implementation.
discrepancies.next_action: Model the locking moment for an assemblable linkage, or state that locking is a physical-test question only.

discrepancies.title: C1 CAD artifacts are illustrative bars, not the modeled mechanism

sides.says: The Fusion sketch draws the coupler from (0, 15) to (25, 15) mm, 25 mm long, and dimensions it as drawn; the CadQuery export places four separate bars and calls the assembly purely illustrative.
The modeled coupler is 60 mm and the loop cannot close.

discrepancies.found_by: Reading the CAD script coordinates against the model inputs.
discrepancies.next_action: Regenerate CAD only after D-002 is resolved; never cite the STEP as evidence the mechanism assembles.

discrepancies.title: Reference and textbook fin-term formulations disagree about the static-margin window

sides.says: Fin CP sweep term uses the root chord; margin 1.55-1.57 cal (inside 1.5-2.0).
Textbook Barrowman sweep term (tip leading-edge sweep X_R) and mid-chord line length give 0.74-0.76 cal (outside 1.5-2.0).

discrepancies.found_by: Independent re-derivation of the fin terms during the 2026-09-28 review.
discrepancies.next_action: A human reviews both formulations against Barrowman (1967) or OpenRocket's component CP output.

discrepancies.title: The static-margin script burns a different motor than the OpenRocket model

sides.says: Motor configuration: AeroTech G64W (29 mm reload).
Hard-coded Estes C6-5: 24 g wet, 11 g dry, 1.8 s burn, CG at 0.520 m.

discrepancies.found_by: Parsing the motor designation from the .ork file.
discrepancies.next_action: Use the OpenRocket motor (or justify the substitute) and record the motor mass data source.

discrepancies.title: Static-margin inputs omit or misread parts of the OpenRocket model

sides.says: Ellipsoid nose cone with a 0.067 kg override mass.
Uses the ogive nose CP coefficient (0.466) and sums only body-tube override masses (1.185 kg).

discrepancies.found_by: Comparing parse_ork() with the .ork XML.
discrepancies.next_action: Reviewer decides whether the omissions matter at the required precision.

discrepancies.title: Model inputs were revised until paper targets were met

sides.says: C5 fins, C6 design point, and C8 fin mass were changed so results match the paper; entries are marked RESOLVED.
Before the change the OpenRocket fins had a 20 mm root chord; the reference script then gave 0.08-0.10 cal.

discrepancies.found_by: Reading the divergence log and the preserved pre-change model.
discrepancies.next_action: Record an independent source for each revised input (drawing, datasheet, measurement), or keep the claims open.

discrepancies.title: No shared design point across the mass, spring, reliability, and structural models

sides.says: Fin volume 3.4 cm^3 each: about 5.3 g in CFRP; four listed parts total 98.1 g.
154 g fin, 120 mm chord, 180 mm span, 205 m/s egress.
15 g fin, 60 mm, 70 m/s egress.
Body-tube dry mass 1.185 kg.

discrepancies.found_by: Cross-reading model inputs during the 2026-09-28 review.
discrepancies.next_action: Define one design point in a single reviewed input file that every model reads.

discrepancies.title: Calculated spring margin is below the stated requirement

sides.says: Requirement: at least 20% margin.

discrepancies.found_by: Requirement R-C6-MARGIN evaluated from the design-point record.
discrepancies.next_action: A human changes the spring, the requirement, or the design point, and records why.

discrepancies.title: Test named for a 20% margin did not enforce it

sides.says: test_design_point_has_20_percent_margin asserted k_required <= 1.2 * k_supplied, which accepts negative margins.
Margin arithmetic is tested directly; the requirement is evaluated by the evidence record.

discrepancies.found_by: Reading the assertion against the test name.
discrepancies.next_action: None.
discrepancies.resolved_by: Test correction in the evidence-discipline change.

discrepancies.title: The reliability simulation cannot produce the failures it counts

sides.says: omega_final is forced to 0 when the toggle event fires; k (N*m/rad) is applied as a constant torque (N*m); latency shifts start time only.
10,000 of 10,000 trials succeed.

discrepancies.found_by: Reading the success criterion against the integrator's event handling.
discrepancies.next_action: Rebuild the simulation so each failure mode it counts can occur, at the shared design point (D-010).

discrepancies.title: The historical 10,000-trial summary could not be reconstructed from its CSV

sides.says: Trials 10000, successes 10000.
Header only: a failure-only export cannot state how many trials ran.

discrepancies.found_by: Evidence Observatory row count (0 data rows).
discrepancies.next_action: None.
discrepancies.resolution: The simulation now writes a run record with trials, successes, failures, and seed; consistency checks K-C7-DENOMINATOR and K-C7-FAILURE-ROWS tie it to the CSV.
discrepancies.resolved_by: Record correction; reproduction is checked by CI.

discrepancies.title: Laminate modulus is below the aluminium comparison

sides.says: Claim: match or exceed aluminium stiffness; relies on increased section thickness.
Ex = 56.68 GPa, below 69.0 GPa.

discrepancies.found_by: Requirement R-C8-MODULUS evaluated from the CLT output.
discrepancies.next_action: Calculate equal-mass section bending stiffness (R-C8-COMPONENT-STIFFNESS) or restate the claim.

discrepancies.title: Architecture diagram omitted the rocket's fins-deployed ignition gate

sides.says: ARMED --> IGNITING on the IGNITE command.
IGNITE is refused unless is_fins_deployed(); the refusal was printed to USB serial only and never reached the telemetry record.

discrepancies.found_by: Reading the IGNITE branch in processSerialCommands().
discrepancies.next_action: Bench-verify that the refusal now reaches the dashboard CSV.
discrepancies.resolution: Diagram updated; the rocket now reports CMD_REJECT:ignite_fins_not_deployed and CMD_REJECT:ignite_not_armed over UART, which the launcher already forwards. Compile-verified only.
discrepancies.resolved_by: Documentation and firmware logging change; not bench-verified.

discrepancies.title: Ignition requires deployed fins, but deployment requires a boost-level acceleration

sides.says: Deploy fires only after a >15 g x-axis reading while not IDLE; IGNITE is refused unless the deploy flag is set.
After sending IGNITE the launcher waits 5 s for IGNITED, then aborts.

discrepancies.found_by: Tracing the nominal command sequence through both firmwares.
discrepancies.next_action: A human decides the intended ordering. On the bench this ordering acts as an extra interlock; do not remove it without a safety review.

discrepancies.title: Live telemetry timestamps are launcher relay times, not rocket sample times

sides.says: T packets are built as T,<launcher millis()>,... when a DATA line is relayed.
T,<ms>,... without saying whose clock.

discrepancies.found_by: Reading processSerial2() in the launcher.
discrepancies.next_action: Proposed protocol change: carry rocket millis, a sequence number, and a boot identifier in DATA. Needs a bench-tested firmware revision.
discrepancies.progress: The audit labels T as launcher_relay_millis and LOG as rocket_millis, and the docs state each clock domain.

discrepancies.title: Launcher reported 0.0 m altitude when the barometer was missing

sides.says: filteredAlt was initialized to 0.0 and sent unchanged when bmpHealthy was false.
ENV altitude field documented as altitude, with no missing-value convention.

discrepancies.found_by: Unknown-is-not-zero audit of telemetry fields.
discrepancies.next_action: Bench-verify that ENV carries nan with the barometer disconnected.
discrepancies.resolution: The launcher sends nan for altitude when the barometer is unavailable; the dashboard shows 'not reported'. Compile-verified only.

discrepancies.title: PID comparison fragmented windows, merged streams, and zero-filled bad samples

sides.says: Samples are grouped by PID setting.
A new window started at every STATUS packet (one per telemetry packet); LOG and T rows shared windows; unparseable values became 0.0.

discrepancies.found_by: Tracing the launcher's T-then-STATUS packet order through the analyzer.
discrepancies.next_action: None.
discrepancies.resolution: Windows change only when gains change; T and LOG are summarized separately; invalid samples are counted and excluded.

discrepancies.title: Bill of materials does not match the actuators in firmware and CAD

sides.says: Five SG90-class servos.
Rocket drives five servos (four canards plus ignition); the launcher drives a sixth. The folding-rocket CAD archive references an MG996R.

discrepancies.found_by: Counting Servo.attach() calls against the BOM.
discrepancies.next_action: Reconcile the BOM with an as-built inventory; record purchased prices where known.

discrepancies.title: The C4 baseline is not the printed prototype

sides.says: Baseline body tube and fins in 7075-T6.
Prototype airframe and folding-fin structure in PLA+ or PETG.

discrepancies.found_by: Comparing material tables.
discrepancies.next_action: State which assembly the 30-40% claim compares, and make the baseline match it.

discrepancies.title: OpenRocket screenshots have no recorded model revision

sides.says: An OpenRocket stability plot with no settings, date, or model hash.
The fins changed substantially in a later revision; the plot may predate it.

discrepancies.found_by: Provenance review of committed images.
discrepancies.next_action: Re-export from the current .ork with its hash and settings recorded, or label the images historical.

discrepancies.title: The deploy bench sketch measures a timer with the same timer

sides.says: Elapsed time from esp_timer_get_time(), polled every 10 us until the callback's flag changes.
Same column layout, synthetic values.

discrepancies.found_by: Reading the sketch against requirement R-C2-JITTER.
discrepancies.next_action: Use an external instrument on GPIO 33 (P-001). Sketch output can only describe callback-to-poll latency.
